lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in at least four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a discernible increase in both cluster diameter and inter-cluster spacing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the primary columns of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extending across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a high-contrast vertical gradient characterized by a bright upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) attached to the lower mid-flank/pectoral region.
